note: Small Winnebago County Conservation park (7 acres) in oak timber on the Winnebago River 4 mi northwest of Lake Mills on A16 (21179 485th St), with adjacent fishing ponds, an open shelter and a playground; the northernmost access to the Winnebago River Water Trail. The county posts no pad sizes, so whether a 23-ft motorhome fits is unconfirmed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $10 electric sites (8), drinking water, pit toilet; added season (opens May 1; closed for 2026 on Nov 3). Note cleaned of field facts. Stays not waterfront (river creek-sized here).
flags: WATERFRONT (confirms not waterfront): the Winnebago River at the park is a narrow meandering channel, about 6-9 m wide on NAIP (300 m frame, 0.33 m/px), well under the ~30 m line, so creek-sized. The gravel drive and turnaround where the camping is (around the pin) are about 60 m east of it under oak timber with a small pond between; no pads are visible under canopy, so no site can be shown on the bank. Overpass was down this session (distances are imagery estimates).
FIT UNCLEAR, keep with caveat: no pad sizes posted; the camping is along a gravel park drive under oaks. Caveat added to the proposed note.
